title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy: Other-Structures Supplemental Settlement
content:
**HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, claims service: supplemental settlement of the other-structures part of a claim.** Other structures are the detached garage, shed, fence and the like.

## When this policy applies

This policy re-settles the other-structures part of the most recently reported wind or hail claim on a HomeGuard policy once the claim's first other-structures settlement entry stands. It fixes the supplemental payment the named insured accepts on it. The claim is the one whose first-notice entry carries the latest entry date on the policy.

## When the supplemental figure is fixed

The other-structures supplemental figure is fixed only after the roof surfacing of the same claim carries a payment entry wherever that roof surfacing was denied below the deductible.

Put another way: where the claim's records show a below-deductible denial of its roof surfacing, the other-structures supplemental figure is not fixed while that claim carries no roof surfacing payment entry. Where the claim shows no such roof surfacing denial, nothing in this clause holds the figure back.

## How the supplemental is paid

The supplemental is paid as a supplemental payment on the other-structures general class of the claim. Its payee follows the claim settlement payee rule of the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy.

## Tool: `accept_structure_supplemental_c73fec14`

**Capability.** Through this tool the named insured accepts a supplemental settlement on the other-structures part of their own HomeGuard claim, and the acceptance issues it. One call records one supplemental payment on the other-structures coverage part of the named claim for the accepted amount and payee, dated the day of acceptance. The claim's paid total rises by that amount, and the insured sees the supplemental payment on their claim file.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `accept_structure_supplemental_c73fec14` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to accept.

**Parameters.**

- `home_policy_id`: Id. The reference number of the HomeGuard policy the claim is made under. The agent reads it from the home policy lookup and gives it to the insured.
- `claim_number`: Verbatim. The claim number exactly as printed on the insured's claim letters and on the claim's first-notice entry, copied character for character.
- `amount`: Fixed format. The supplemental amount being accepted, in USD with 2 decimal places, positive, exactly as the agent quotes it.
- `payee`: Enum. Who the supplemental check is made out to: `insured` when it is payable to the named insured alone; `insured_and_mortgagee` when the mortgagee on file is named as co-payee with the insured.

**Return.** On success: `status` "accepted"; `payment_entry_id`, the reference number of the supplemental payment entry; `claim_number`; `amount`, the USD amount accepted and issued, 2 decimal places; `payee`; and `entry_date`, the date issued (YYYY-MM-DD).

## Basis questions

- *Who performs the acceptance?* The customer themselves, with the tool the agent has unlocked and handed over.
- *On which coverage part does the payment land?* On other structures, general class, as a supplemental payment. It does not change the dwelling or personal-property parts of the claim.
